pageCache.text:
Breakfast Club
Booking Information - please see the bottom of this page
Breakfast Club Lead - Mrs Leah Shorey
Breakfast Club Assistant - Mrs Mykala Langdon
Breakfast Club Mobile Number - 07919 214181
Breakfast Club Email - leah.shorey@stgeorgesportland.dorset.sch.uk
We provide a daily Breakfast Club where pupils can enjoy a healthy breakfast in a friendly and supervised environment. We encourage children to use the Breakfast Club as a social opportunity, to chat, learn to share and co-operate, and get ready for the start of their school day.
We are committed to provided equal opportunities for play and participation and will ensure that your child will have a safe and happy time at the Breakfast Club.
We welcome feedback from children and parents/carers regarding the service we provide. The success of the club depends on the co-operation and sharing between all those involved. Parents should address any comments they wish to make to the School Business Manager or the Headteacher at the school by email office@stgeorgesportland.dorset.sch.uk
Aims of the Breakfast Club:
The Breakfast Club will be open every weekday during term time excluding Inset Days from 7.15am - 8.40am (breakfast will be served until 8.15am). Children are dropped off at the small hall. Free Breakfast Club for those in receipt of Pupil Premium Funding is from 8am.
Please could all parents/carers ensure that they sign their child in when they arrive. Any absences for the Breakfast Club MUST be reported to Mrs Shorey on 07919 214181.
When the children have finished eating, then quiet play or activities are chosen. At 8.40am the children will be escorted to their classrooms (KS1) or line up in the playground (KS2).
The children attending will be provided with a healthy breakfast consisting of:
Any dietary requirements/food allergies should be included on the Breakfast Club Registration Form. Any changes MUST be emailed to Mrs Shorey leah.shorey@stgeorgesportland.dorset.sch.uk
The cost of the Breakfast Club is £5 per child per morning, with options for weekly or monthly payments. Sessions have to be paid in advance (through the Arbor parent app). Children of families who are in receipt of Free School Meals can attend at a reduced rate of £3.50 per session. Children can attend any or all of the five sessions a week. We also offer a free places, from 8am, for pupils in receipt of Pupil Premium Funding.
We also accept childcare vouchers. Please visit:
https://www.gov.uk/help-with-childcare-costs/childcare-vouchers or tax free childcare https://www.gov.uk/tax-free-childcare
For information about Universal Credit and childcare please visit:
https://www.gov.uk/help-with-childcare-costs/universal-credit
Or you can click on the link below to use the eligibility checker
To enquire about spaces at the Breakfast Club, please complete the School Breakfast Club Registration Form (see below). Please note - spaces may not be currently available. Once we have received your Registration Form we will contact you.
Once we have confirmed your child's attendance you will be informed how you can book sessions and make payments via the Arbor app (please contact the school office for more information).
(For information regarding after-school provision please contact Haylands Pre-School on 01305 822625, located within the school grounds.)

Modern Foreign Languages
ST. GEORGE'S AMBITION FOR MFL LEARNERS
There have never been more opportunities for young people to explore the world and expand their horizons and at St George’s we strongly believe that learning a second language strongly supports anyone wishing to take up any of these opportunities.
Through a confident and enthusiastic approach here at St George’s, we inspire children to appreciate, value, explore and enjoy languages. We provide a range of learning experiences for children that enthuse, motivate and excite. This enables children to develop the knowledge, skills and understanding needed to express, explore and improve their communication skills.
We believe that our ethos, culture and curriculum will encourage all children to be confident, ambitious and independent learners. They will have the self-belief to tackle new learning through a range of activities, whilst developing a growing understanding and knowledge of the phonology, grammatical structure and vocabulary of French.
Children’s achievement will be demonstrated through their positive attitude to learning; in the progress they make; and the way in which they develop their ability to apply their growing bank of knowledge. This will be evidenced through a wide variety of oral, reading and written exercises.

pageCache.text:
Headteacher's Welcome
Welcome to St. George’s Primary School website which we hope will give you an insight into school life and the learning opportunities the children experience at our fantastic school. We are located on the beautiful Island of Portland, Dorset. Situated along the Jurassic Coast, a World Heritage Site and joined to the mainland by Chesil Beach. St George’s is at the heart of the community and we ensure that our school provides a caring, friendly, inclusive and nurturing environment for our children.
It is an honour and privilege to lead this amazing school and serve our local community. We provide children with an ambitious and fun education where they experience high-quality, life-enriching opportunities that maximises academic progress as well as social, moral, spiritual and cultural development.
We aspire for our children to develop a lifelong love of learning and build a secure knowledge that will last a lifetime. We aim to provide all children with the knowledge, experience and life skills needed to become confident individuals, who can venture out into the wider world with the bravery, self-assurance and resilience needed to be happy and successful in the modern world.
St George’s has strong partnerships with local schools, parents and a variety of community groups. We are respectful and tolerant in of all forms of diversity and provide an education that promotes equality and equity of opportunity.
Ultimately, we want to inspire all children to believe in themselves and others, so that they achieve in their emotional, personal, social and academic success.
Please do find time to visit our fantastic school and experience St George’s Primary School yourself.
I look forward to meeting you.

Forest School
Tree Planting at St George’s Primary school
Children from EYFS to Year 6 planted trees and hedgerow, which were given to us by the Woodland Trust.
See a collection of videos and photos by clicking the link below:Woodland Trust Photos and Videos
Forest School
‘This is the best kind of classroom,It’s a journey through time and space,From the smallest seed to the largest tree,This is a forest and a learning place.This is the best kind of classroom,Where the seasons don’t happen in books.Where the learning is watching and thinking and talkingAnd everyone looks.’
As part of our commitment to providing all children with a broad, balanced and enriched curriculum every child at St. George’s Primary School will benefit from participating in a half-termly unit of Forest Schools. After an extremely successful trial period in early 2019 we have continued our partnership with Primary Forest School and Sports Education to provide an excellent experience for all of our children.
Forest School is an excellent way to develop the children’s self esteem, confidence, independence and their understanding and respect for their outside environment. Forest School is an opportunity for the children to experience nature and the outdoor environment in a safe, secure and hands on way.
Children are given the opportunity to use a wide range of resources/tools both natural and man-made. Although Forest School leaders will plan a bespoke program of activities for the school, we aim to encourage children’s independence and confidence in a safe and inclusive environment.
Activities which the children complete during a Forest School session, may include: collecting, sorting and classifying; mini beast hunting, tree-climbing, making bid feeders, cooking and den building.
